The final project is your chance to build something of your own design. It is
**individual**: everyone does their own project. Use the workflow from the
semester (agent → code → artifact) and any of the things we've built along the
way: websites, writing, images, animation, sound, documents, data
visualizations, and slides.

We introduce the project in Week 8, so you have time to think about what you
want to make before the proposal is due.

**Summary of deliverables:**

<div style="width:600px">

Item | Weight | Grading | Due
-----|--------|---------|-----------------
[Proposal](1-proposal.qmd) | 2% | Completion (1 / 0) | Oct 27 (Week 10)
[Final Project](2-final.qmd) | 18% | 0 / 0.5 / 1 ([rubric](../syllabus.qmd#final-project-rubric)) | Dec 8

</div>

The final submission is a link to a GitHub repository with your project and all
of its source files, a 5-minute video about your project posted to YouTube, your
agent transcripts, and a report of your token usage. A few projects will be
showcased at the start of the final exam.
